name: stackblitz-rate-limits
description: Establish evidence-based WebContainer capacity budgets for boot concurrency, mounted files, dependency installs, processes, previews, memory symptoms, and browser support. Use when a StackBlitz experience is slow, unstable, or being prepared for wider rollout. Trigger with "WebContainer limits", "StackBlitz capacity", or "WebContainer performance budget".
